info.description: Yggdrasil owns this contract; Leviathan vendors it verbatim. Separate from telemetry-only Uplink. Strict JSON: no duplicate or unknown fields, maximum 256 KiB, no redirects. Remote messages never select commands, paths, service names or hooks. Release manifests use canonical compact JSON and Ed25519 signature over leviathan-release-v1 followed by a newline and manifest bytes. Stable releases only, exact compatible state/config profiles, no downgrade.
